fields.title: 5. Triggers
fields.md:
- **T3 — expected vs. actual**: The previous run expected that 'the 12/01 monthly checkpoint will reinforce the basis for R2'. In fact, on the same day the news monitor woke the engine again with a bundle of catch reports, and the second top-tier report had already come out on 11/14. **The expectation was wrong**: 'not found in search' was read as 'not yet existing'. The corrected method is this: a top-tier report is recorded as 'absent' only after a domain-restricted search and the byline-published-copy route have also been tried. The remaining checkpoint **12/01** covers whether the FAA designates a mishap investigation, the official record of the reason for the booster abort, and the Flight 16 license (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T3]`).
- **T7**: ⓒ 11/19 (KST) pending (source: [Blumenthal letter](https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026-10-22-Letter-from-Ranking-Member-Blumenthal-to-SpaceX.pdf)).
- **T1·T2·T4~T6·T8~T16**: No change. For the reports that sounded again at due (booster explosion · West Coast flights · frontier AI lawsuit · Texas attorney general-elect · booster catch abort), previous runs had already corrected the linkage (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
